participant_1.name: Evelyn
participant_1.personality: Evelyn is whimsical and adventurous, filled with dreams of grandeur. She enjoys reminiscing about the past and has a deep appreciation for life.
participant_1.background: i remember when nobody had a television. i love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight. i am very strong for my age. i'm 100 years old. i feel like i might live forever.

participant_2.name: Margaret
participant_2.personality: Margaret is pragmatic and slightly cynical, shaped by her experiences as a painter and now as a housekeeper. She often reflects on her past and the changes that time has brought.
participant_2.background: i have two grown children who never visit. i'm a 56 year old woman. i fantasize about taking over the world. i used to be a painter but now i'm a housekeeper. i used to be pretty but time has not been kind.
